targets.title: Features of similarity
targets.evidence_quote: Therefore, we set out to perform a pre-registered replication of both Study 1 and Study 2 reported in Tversky ( 1977 ).
targets.outcome_quote: Thus, as the meta-analysis indicates, without eliminating possible substitution effects we replicate the original findings by Tversky ( 1977 ) and Tversky and Gati ( 1978 ). However, eliminating substitution effects strongly reduces the observed differences between conditions with averages of 2.89% (1a), 17.5% (1b), −1.21% (2a), and 1.24% (2b). Overall the size of differences between conditions, when substitution effects were eliminated, clustered around zero (see Figure 6 ).
targets.outcome_reasoning: The authors replicate the original choice pattern but identify substitution as a central confound; the effect disappears overall once that confound is eliminated. This is the paper’s main message, with the explicit joint verdict naming both originals.

reasoning: Four new-sample studies re-test two cited original publications: the 1977 paper and the 1978 detailed report of the country experiment. Both are explicitly named as re-tested and jointly evaluated. Other papers are literature context; the calculation from Zhou supplied choice counts evaluates a contrast that Zhou did not originally report, rather than re-testing Zhou’s own cross-cultural finding.
